findings.F1: The book loses mainly because it is short while the coins rise. Its per-bar position gain is -0.0283 %, and -0.0241 % of that comes from the market's own rise against the short; timing adds only -0.0042 %. Over its 213 first-in-cell cases the short's total move is -3.97 % per 26 days against an unusual move of +0.46 %.
findings.F2: The cloud's thinness carries nothing. The step-5 check gives a thin-minus-thick Welch t of -0.36 over 198 cases, with an unusual move of -0.19 % (strength -0.020), so neither the main measure nor the grading the forecast is sized by is in the data.
findings.F3: Among the book's cases, the short's unusual move depends on how far the coin had already fallen. After a 26-day fall deeper than about -20 % it is +4.4 % (t 1.26, 50 cases), and the total move is +0.3 %. After a 26-day return above about -6 % it is -4.9 % (t -1.04), and the total move is -9.0 %. The 10-day return grades the same way: below about -13 %, +6.0 % (t 1.64, 58 cases); above about -6 %, -3.4 %.
findings.F4: The short worked better when the coin was turbulent. In the high-volatility tercile of 20-day daily moves the unusual move is +4.4 % (t 1.33, 58 cases); in the low tercile it is -3.9 % (t -1.48).
findings.F5: The result swings by year. The unusual move is +18.7 % in 2018 (25 cases) and +5.6 % in 2025. It is -10.2 % in 2021 and -7.3 % in 2023. On the daily book the 2023 mean is -0.22 % against holding's +0.15 %.
findings.F6: On a 26-day grid over all bars, the side of the cloud predicts the next 26 days. Above the cloud the unusual move is +12.5 % (t 2.57, 59 cases) and the total move +19.5 %. Inside the cloud it is -12.9 % (t -2.96, 25 cases). Below the cloud it is -7.0 % (t -1.78, 59 cases).
findings.F7: The effect grows with the close's distance from the cloud's middle, but not past it on the downside. More than 11 % above the middle, the unusual move is +10.7 % (t 2.40, 36 cases) and the total +17.8 %. Between 17 % and 1 % below the middle, it is -13.7 % (t -4.16, 36 cases) and the total -6.2 %. More than 17 % below, it is only -4.2 % (t -0.72).
findings.F8: Below the cloud, the coin falls further when it is already falling. With a 26-day return under about -5.6 %, the unusual move is -8.9 % (t -2.08, 20 cases) and -16.7 % (t -2.54, 19 cases). With a 26-day return above that, it is +4.0 % (total +11.2 %, 20 cases).
findings.F9: Above the cloud, a thick cloud is followed by the larger rise, the opposite of the brief's grading. With a width above 5.6 % of the price, the unusual move is +26.5 % (t 2.28, 20 cases); with a width below 2.4 %, it is +5.6 %.
findings.F10: The size is far from the cost. A round trip costs 0.19 %, while the moves the cloud separates are 6 % to 18 % of total move per 26 days (F6, F7). The cost does not cause the failure; the direction of the bet does.

ideas.idea: After a daily close that crosses down from above a coin's Ichimoku cloud to below it, the coin falls over the next 26 days, only while its 26-day return is already a fall, and the deeper that 26-day fall at the cross, the larger the fall that follows.
ideas.consequence: A trader would short a downward cloud break only when it confirms an ongoing slide, and would refuse the shallow breaks that tend to rebound with the coin's drift.
ideas.name: cloud breakdown after deep fall

ideas.idea: While a coin's daily close is below the middle of its Ichimoku cloud, the coin falls over the next 26 days, and the larger its 26-day fall, the larger the fall that follows.
ideas.consequence: A falling coin sitting under its cloud is a reason to be short or out over the following weeks, and the reason is stronger the steeper the recent slide.
ideas.name: falling coin under cloud

ideas.idea: A coin whose daily close stands above its Ichimoku cloud rises over the next 26 days, and the further the close stands above the cloud's middle as a share of the price, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: A trader would be long the coin over the following weeks when it trades well above its cloud, and more so the wider that gap.
ideas.name: distance above cloud rises

ideas.idea: A coin trading above its Ichimoku cloud rises over the next 26 days, and the thicker the cloud as a share of the price, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: A trend that holds above a thick cloud is a reason to stay long for weeks, the opposite of reading a thin cloud as the stronger signal.
ideas.name: thick cloud supports rise
